schema.title: DIAL Chat managed configuration
schema.description: Values published through Config Studio for one ai-dial-chat instance. A Chat deployment applies them only when its managed reading is enabled; an explicit deployment environment override still wins, and omitted keys use the application default.

announcement.title.title: Banner title
announcement.title.description: Plain text in bold at the start of the announcement banner; markup is shown as typed. Omit it for a banner without a heading.

announcement.description.title: Banner text
announcement.description.description:
Shown after the banner title. HTML: bold (, ), italic (), line break (
), and links (). Everything else is removed, and a link keeps only its address, target and rel; links to other pages open in a new tab.

title.title: Title
title.description: Plain text; markup is shown as typed.

description.title: Description
description.description:
Optional. HTML: bold (, ), italic (), line break (
), and links (). Everything else is removed, and a link keeps only its address, target and rel; links to other pages open in a new tab.

link.title: Link
link.description: Optional call to action shown after the description.

href.title: Address
href.description: An http:// or https:// address. It opens in a new tab.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: warning highlights the entry; info is the default.

announcement.items.title: Announcements
announcement.items.description: Listed, in this order, behind the banner's "+N announcements" pill; at most 10. An entry whose link address cannot be opened is dropped.

welcomeScreen.description.title: Welcome text
welcomeScreen.description.description: Plain text below the greeting on the new-chat screen; markup is shown as typed.

id.title: ID
id.description: Letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, at most 64. Each browser remembers the ids it has shown, so a new id shows the hint again to everyone; editing the text or the order does not. When two hints share an id, only the first is shown.

target.title: Target
target.description: The on-screen element the hint points at. The tour skips a hint whose element is not on the current page and shows it on a page that renders it.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional plain text below the title.

onboarding.hints.title: Onboarding tour
onboarding.hints.description: Hints shown one at a time, in this order, to users who have not seen them. Each points at an on-screen element; at most 50. A hint whose id repeats an earlier one is dropped.

ui.activeEventId.title: Celebration event
ui.activeEventId.description: The seasonal celebration shown on the start page: halloween or new-year, or none to turn celebrations off. An event without a built-in module plays only when it is listed under external events and its pack is available; an unknown event shows nothing.

ui.celebrationsEnabledByDefault.title: Celebrations on by default
ui.celebrationsEnabledByDefault.description: Whether users who never changed the celebrations switch in Settings see the celebration event. A choice a user saved always wins.

ui.celebrationDelivery.mode.title: Celebration scene source
ui.celebrationDelivery.mode.description: For built-in events: bundled plays only built-in scenes; prefer-external also takes the scenes listed under Scenes from packs from the celebration packs this deployment serves, and keeps the built-in scenes when a pack is unavailable. External events come from their pack either way.

ui.celebrationDelivery.revision.title: Celebration restart token
ui.celebrationDelivery.revision.description: Change it to restart a scene that is already playing; changing the event, the source or the allowed scenes restarts it anyway. 1–64 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

ui.celebrationDelivery.externalScenes.title: Scenes from packs
ui.celebrationDelivery.externalScenes.description: Scenes of built-in events that may come from a celebration pack, each as eventId/sceneId, for example new-year/snowman-delivery; at most 64. Used only when the scene source is prefer-external.

ui.celebrationDelivery.externalEvents.title: External events
ui.celebrationDelivery.externalEvents.description: Events without a built-in module that may come entirely from a celebration pack this deployment serves, for example company-anniversary; at most 64. An external event that is selected but not listed here shows nothing.

fileManager.availableTabs.title: File Manager tabs
fileManager.availableTabs.description: Which File Manager tabs users see. Tabs always appear in the order All, My files, Shared, Organization; the order here does not matter. All appears only with at least two other tabs.

usageLimits.warningThresholdPercent.title: Usage warning threshold (%)
usageLimits.warningThresholdPercent.description: Share of a capped day, week or month limit at which the usage banner appears above the message box. The usage dial and the Usage page keep their own 75% mark.

usageLimits.spendingLimitsMode.title: Spending limits mode
usageLimits.spendingLimitsMode.description: Must equal DIAL Core's spending-limits mode. off: budgets are hidden. shadow: budgets are shown as not yet enforced. enforce: only budgets are shown. It changes what Chat shows, not what DIAL Core enforces.

features.usageLimitsControl.title: Usage-limits control
features.usageLimitsControl.description: Shows the token and cost usage-limits control next to the model selector.

dial:semanticConstraints.description: The date and time must exist in the proleptic Gregorian calendar.
When both are present, startsAt must be earlier than endsAt.

utcTimestamp.title: UTC timestamp
utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC (Z suffix), for example 2026-11-01T08:00:00Z.

availability.title: Availability window
availability.description: startsAt is inclusive, endsAt exclusive; omit a boundary for no limit. startsAt must precede endsAt.

targeting.title: Targeting
targeting.description: Users need at least one listed verified role. Omit targeting for no restriction.
